content.text: Chrome is fully closed (the lingering PID 2417 is just a zombie). Now I'll update both config files to set the profile name to "Thomas".

input.command:
# Backup the files first
cp ~/.config/google-chrome/Local\ State ~/.config/google-chrome/Local\ State.bak
cp ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences ~/.config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences.bak
echo "Backups created"

python3 << 'EOF'
import json
from pathlib import Path

home = Path.home()
ls_path = home / ".config/google-chrome/Local State"
pref_path = home / ".config/google-chrome/Default/Preferences"

# Update Local State
with open(ls_path, "r") as f:
    ls = json.load(f)

ls["profile"]["info_cache"]["Default"]["name"] = "Thomas"
ls["profile"]["info_cache"]["Default"]["is_using_default_name"] = False

with open(ls_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(ls, f, separators=(",", ":"))

# Update Default/Preferences
with open(pref_path, "r") as f:
    pref = json.load(f)

pref.setdefault("profile", {})["name"] = "Thomas"

with open(pref_path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(pref, f, separators=(",", ":"))

# Verify
with open(ls_path) as f:
    ls2 = json.load(f)
print("Local State name:", ls2["profile"]["info_cache"]["Default"]["name"])
print("Local State is_using_default_name:", ls2["profile"]["info_cache"]["Default"]["is_using_default_name"])

with open(pref_path) as f:
    pref2 = json.load(f)
print("Preferences name:", pref2["profile"]["name"])
EOF
input.description: Update profile name to Thomas in both config files
